correctness.rationale: All 2π-periodic nonresonant arrivals have exactly two release-phase stationary points by reflection-rigidity of the monotone symmetric velocity, and these are the globally unique min/max; strict positivity makes both scalar equations invertible. The primitive is strictly concave and reflection-symmetric, forcing W≤4δ, with equality precisely at r=π. Implicit differentiation gives the full-cycle cusp with uniform O(η²). Actual packaged verification.py separately passed 495 finite checks; the analytic argument, not samples, proves the quantified theorem.

value.rationale: A natural sensor-separation design question is solved globally across the entire admissible positive even half-wave-symmetric flow class. The unique optimizer is waveform-independent although attainable width depends on the waveform; the exact extrema, cusp and complete nulls quantify sensitivity and identifiability. This is a structural benchmark, not a routine numerical example or an assertion about realistic multi-dimensional tidal transport.
